subject: MAP: Acceptance window recalibration and contingency proposal
messages:
From: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@acmeops.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: MAP: Acceptance window recalibration and contingency proposal

Hi Rishi / Laura —

Quick update from our side after the engineering review this morning: the internal acceptance window we committed to for the eval (target go-live 2027-03-20) looks optimistic. Two items are trending late on our end: procurement sign-off for the network diagram (security review queue) and a resources shift in infra (they absorbed another urgent integration).

We need a concrete next step: either push target go-live by one week (to 2027-03-27) or accept a phased acceptance (critical APIs first, then metrics dashboard). Both options have implications for our finance/quarterly planning.

Can Redwood provide a short contingency MAP that captures: new milestones, fallbacks, and a temporary SLA credit if we exceed the original window? If procurement needs formal evidence for SOC2 alignment, Emily will attach the checklist.

Appended: procurement note (below).

--
Emily Zhou
Senior Program Manager, AcmeOps
emily.zhou@acmeops.com

-----Original Message from Procurement-----
From: AcmeOps Procurement <procurement@acmeops.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: SOC2 evidence queue
To: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@acmeops.com>

We received a KBA that requires vendor SOC2 evidence and a hosted data flow diagram. Current SLA for reviews is 10 business days.
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@acmeops.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 10:14:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP: Acceptance window recalibration and contingency proposal

Emily — thanks for the heads up and for pasting the procurement note. I pushed a quick draft MAP to cover both options and flagged fallback lanes; attaching MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet) that lays out milestones, owners, and conditional SLAs. High-level summary below: 

1) Phased acceptance option (preferred):
   - Week 1 (by 2027-03-20): API endpoints + auth flows — Redwood will allocate dedicated test window and provide token-level latency reports.
   - Week 2 (by 2027-03-27): Dashboard and metrics + final KV cache tuning.
   - Fallback: if procurement delays evidence beyond 7 business days, we automatically push the dashboard cutover by one sprint and keep APIs live.

2) Single-shift option (push target):
   - New target: 2027-03-27 full acceptance.
   - Redwood proposes a 3-day SLA credit (per accepted scope) if we miss the revised target due to Redwood-resourced delivery issues.

We can be firmer on the credit if needed — Laura / Grace, is there runway in our credit policy for incremental short credits for mid-market deals?

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@acmeops.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP: Acceptance window recalibration and contingency proposal

Thanks Rishi — MAP looks sensible. A few procurement and legal notes before we go live with a formal MAP: 

- Procurement will need the SOC2 evidence packet. Grace, please confirm we can share the hosted data flow and the standard evidence bundle.
- On credits: we can offer a one-time service credit up to 5% of projected first-month usage for a single-week slip. Anything beyond that requires approval.
- We should avoid committing to automatic SLA credits as a default; propose a conditional credit line in the MAP with an exec sign-off step.

Emily — I suggest we convene a short call tomorrow to pick between phased vs single-shift. Rishi, please prepare a one-slide decision table and track changes to the MAP file (use the attached redlines_acme_contract.docx to capture any terms that Procurement may ask to surface).

Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: AcmeOps Procurement <procurement@acmeops.com>, Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@acmeops.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 09:28:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP: Acceptance window recalibration and contingency proposal

Hi Emily / Procurement —

Happy to share the SOC2 evidence bundle and hosted data flow. Attaching SOC2-evidence-request.pdf to this thread. A few clarifications:

- The hosted flow diagram is redacted for internal IP, but contains all control mappings required for a procurement review.
- We can expedite the evidence handoff on a 3-business-day turnaround if Procurement confirms which specific control IDs are required; otherwise we default to the standard 10 business days.

Rishi / Laura — I copied Jonas because this may need an exec exception if the procurement timeline forces a go-live beyond the quarter. If Procurement sticks to 10 business days and AcmeOps requests the original 2027-03-20 date, we will likely need a formal exception to our credit policy.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@acmeops.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 17:43:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP: Acceptance window recalibration and contingency proposal

Team / Emily —

Thanks for the clear options. Executive position: we approve a one-week push to 2027-03-27 with the following conditions: 

1) Rapid evidence path: Procurement confirms within 24 hours which control IDs are required. If they do, Grace to own 3-business-day evidence turnaround.
2) Conditional credit: Redwood will provision a single, capped service credit equal to 3% of estimated first-month usage if Redwood delivery causes a further slip beyond 2027-03-27. This is subject to final legal wording (redlines_acme_contract.docx).
3) Phased acceptance remains available if AcmeOps prefers minimizing production risk; we will prioritize API endpoints in week-of-2027-03-20 test window.

Emily — please confirm procurement's requested control list (or confirm they can accept the standard bundle). Rishi / Laura / Grace — Rishi, please send the single-slide decision table and upload the updated MAP_v2.xlsx to the HubSpot deal. I'll sign off on the conditional credit language if Legal clears the redlines.

-Jonas
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
